Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Lifted Apple (AAPL) Stake By $727,804; Farmers Capital Bank Has 1.68 Sentiment 
March 24, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
Farmers Capital Bank Corporation, a bank holding company, provides banking and bank-related services to individual, business, agriculture, government, and educational customers. The company has market cap of $293.57 million. The Company’s primary deposit products include checking, savings, and term certificate accounts, as well as time and demand deposits; and lending products comprise residential mortgage, commercial lending, and consumer installment loans. It has a 25.1 P/E ratio. The firm also offers other services, such as cash management, letters of credit issuing, safe deposit box rental, and funds transfer services; and other financial instruments, such as deposit accounts in other financial institutions and federal funds sold.
